title: Azure App Service Deployment
description: Deploy ASP.NET Core apps to Azure App Service using C#, deployment slots, and monitoring.
longDescription: Learn how to deploy an ASP.NET Core web app to Azure App Service. You will configure App Service plans, deploy from Visual Studio and GitHub Actions, use deployment slots, connect a custom domain, and read basic diagnostics.
whatYouLearn: Explain Azure App Service and App Service plans
Deploy an ASP.NET Core app from Visual Studio and CLI
Use deployment slots and custom domains
Monitor app health with logs and App Service diagnostics
